frequency_question: How often do newly introduced Treasury open market intervention programs successfully ramp up to their projected maximum operational volumes within their designated rollout timelines?
membership_rule: Includes major U.S. Treasury debt buyback, liquidity injection, or quantitative easing/tightening operational scaling phases initiated since 2000; excludes emergency ad-hoc crisis interventions with no prior schedule.

cases.name: 2024 Treasury Buyback Program initial rollout phase

coverage_note: 8 named historical programmatic scaling phases; represents the universe of systematic U.S. monetary/debt management expansion programs in the 21st century.

multiplier: 8 hits out of 8 applicable structured operational scaling phases.
validity_reason: Operational mechanics of Treasury and Federal Reserve debt intervention programs remain structurally consistent across standard economic cycles.
